notes: Plugin installed over the GraphQL upload route and reported compatible on boot 1. Volume shape: a host directory mounted at the image's data path; the container was STOPPED and STARTED, and the mount is what carries the data across.

volume.ownership_fixup: chown -R 999:999 on the host directory was refused; Docker Desktop's VM handles uid mapping on this platform, so the mount is expected to work regardless — recorded rather than assumed

cursor_probe.reason: the cursorless control query did not resolve after the restart (Error: Failed to send request: RepositoryError(ConnectionFailed(MissingConnectionPool)))
cursor_probe.notes: control_query_resolved is the attribution control: a CURSORLESS query run at the same moment. When it is false, the cursored query was never run and resolved_after_restart is null, because a failure that every query shares says nothing about cursor lifetime. O-04, recorded as an observation. The shipped design does not depend on it: the durable resume position is scans.last_request_id, a re-derivable decimal integer, and init() NULLs scans.last_cursor on every boot, so a resume after restart always goes through last_request_id whatever this says. A negative result here is a measurement, not a defect.
